optimized_sql:
WITH de_movies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT mc.movie_id
    FROM company_name AS cn
    JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[de]'
),
keyword_movies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM keyword AS k
    JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
)
SELECT MIN(t.title) AS movie_title
FROM de_movies
JOIN keyword_movies ON keyword_movies.movie_id = de_movies.movie_id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = de_movies.movie_id AND t.id = keyword_movies.movie_id
